items.raw_excerpt: Una exfuncionaria la acusó de usar el móvil destinado a sus traslados oficiales para ir a un Starbucks y al médico.
items.summary_en: A former employee accused a Biobío regional official of using her government vehicle for personal trips to Starbucks and to the doctor. The case was filed with Chile's Comptroller General for misuse of public property. Local media reported the incident on Monday.

items.title_original: Seremi del Biobío fue denunciada en Contraloría por mal uso de vehículo fiscal

items.raw_excerpt: Drinking water could become more expensive in Switzerland; Aargau municipality shuts off fountains due to water theft; and more Swiss news in our roundup on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: A small town in Aargau has padlocked its public drinking fountains. Officials say people have been stealing water from the taps. The story highlights growing concerns about water costs in Switzerland.

items.title_original: Today in Switzerland: A roundup of the latest news on Tuesday

items.raw_excerpt: The amount of people in the Netherlands who are single is rising, and a growing number are in relationships with a partner they do not live with, new figures from statistics agency CBS show. In 2025, 30% of adults said they had no long-term partner, up from 27% in 2013. A further 10% were in a so-called “living apart together” relationship – a couple who keep separate homes – compared with 8% in 2013. The remaining 60% lived with a...
items.summary_en: The number of single adults in the Netherlands is increasing. According to CBS statistics, 30% of adults in 2025 have no long-term partner, up from 27% in 2013. Additionally, 10% are in 'living apart together' relationships.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 통계청(CBS)에 따르면 2025년 성인의 30%가 장기 파트너가 없는 것으로 나타났다. 이는 2013년의 27%에서 증가한 수치이며, 10%는 '별거 관계'를 유지하고 있다.
items.title_en: More Dutch adults are single or living apart, says CBS
items.title_ko: 네덜란드 CBS, 독신 또는 별거 성인 증가
items.title_original: More Dutch adults are single or living apart, says CBS

items.raw_excerpt: Bombay HC orders Maharashtra FDA to pay ₹5 lakh for unjustly suspending Pune sweets shop's license despite high compliance.
items.summary_en: Bombay High Court ordered Maharashtra FDA to pay 5 lakh rupees for wrongly suspending a Pune sweets shop's license. The shop had high compliance but FDA refused to restore the licence. The court said FDA was going overboard in its action.
items.summary_ko: Bombay 고법은 Maharashtra FDA가 푸네 제과점 면허를 부당하게 정지시킨 것에 대해 500만루피를 부과했다. 해당 가게는 높은 준수율을 보였으나 FDA가 면허를 복원하지 않았다. 법원은 FDA의 행동이 지나쳤다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: You are going overboard: Bombay HC imposes 5 lakh cost on FDA for not restoring Pune shop's licence
items.title_ko: 부당한 푸네 가게 면허 정지: Bombay 고법, FDA에 500만루피 과징금
items.title_original: 'You are going overboard': Bombay HC imposes ₹5 lakh cost on FDA for not restoring Pune shop's licence

items.raw_excerpt: The Teachers' Union of Ireland has said that the retention of teachers within the system is now "as big a challenge as initial recruitment".
items.summary_en: The Teachers' Union of Ireland says keeping teachers in schools is now as hard as hiring new ones. The union is calling on the government to make teaching a more appealing career. This comes as schools across Ireland struggle with teacher shortages.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 교사노조는 교사 이직 문제가 신규 채용만큼 심각하다고 밝혔다. 노조는 정부에 교직의 매력도를 높이기 위한 구체적인 대책을 마련할 것을 요구했다. 이는 전국 학교들의 교사 부족 문제를 해결하기 위한 목소리이다.
items.title_en: Government urged to make teaching more attractive

items.raw_excerpt: This week’s episode of Sweden in Focus Extra features an interview with Luisa Fernandez and Gustav Magnusson, a couple facing an uncertain future in Sweden after Luisa's application for permanent residency was rejected.
items.summary_en: Luisa Fernandez and Gustav Magnusson are a couple living in Sweden facing an uncertain future. Luisa's application for permanent residency was rejected. They are determined to fight to stay in the country they call home.

items.title_en: I'll do everything I can to stay in Sweden because this is our home

items.raw_excerpt: South East Water says its teams are exhausted as it tries to restore water to areas in Kent.
items.summary_en: South East Water is working to restore water to parts of Kent. The company says its teams are exhausted from the effort. Residents have been told the outage could continue for several more days.

items.raw_excerpt: A neighbour of a cracked and deteriorating Auckland heritage building wants to see a collective effort to repair it.
items.summary_en: A neighbour of a cracked and deteriorating Auckland heritage building is calling for a collective effort to repair it. The building's owner and the local council are being urged to work together. The neighbour says the situation is urgent and needs immediate attention.

items.title_original: 'It's going to hurt' - neighbour wants council to work with owner of cracked heritage building

items.raw_excerpt: Philosophy teachers say the inclusion of their subject in the secondary school curriculum from 2029 is a huge step.
items.summary_en: Philosophy will be included in New Zealand's secondary school curriculum starting in 2029. Teachers call it a breakthrough for critical thinking. The subject has long been absent from many schools.

items.raw_excerpt: Thousands of students will get their Leaving Cert results on Friday and many of them will be wondering what their futures hold.
items.summary_en: Thousands of students across Ireland will receive their Leaving Cert results this Friday. Many will be uncertain about their future paths. A young butcher in Louth says choosing an apprenticeship instead of college was the best decision for him.

items.raw_excerpt: A bill returning more than 3000 hectares to Māori in Te Tauihu has unanimously passed its third and final reading.
items.summary_en: A New Zealand bill has passed to return more than 3000 hectares to Māori in the Nelson region. The Nelson Tenths bill unanimously passed its third and final reading, settling a land dispute that has lasted nearly 200 years.

items.raw_excerpt: Saint-Héand vient d’obtenir le label départemental “village Sport Nature” synonyme d'offre d’activités de pleine nature.
items.summary_en: The commune of Saint-Héand in France's Loire department has earned the official "Sport Nature Village" label. The designation recognizes the village's offer of outdoor nature activities for residents and visitors.

items.raw_excerpt: When Eyewitness News attempted to cross the poorly built bridge, the first thing that stood out was the structure swaying from side to side with every uneven step.
items.summary_en: In Limpopo, South Africa, villagers must pay R20 to cross a shaky makeshift bridge to reach the nearest local clinic. The bridge sways with every step and was poorly built. Residents have no other safe way to get medical care.

items.summary_en: Hot weather has made many Swiss lakes warmer than usual this summer. The water temperature is at the upper end of what is considered normal. People are wondering if it is still safe to swim in these warm lakes.
